sections.title: Pre-Hunt Checklist
sections.subtitle: Two minutes here saves ten minutes of carting.

items.heading: Canteen first
items.body: Eat for Well-Fed plus an element attack buff. Food buffs persist until you cart.

items.heading: Element check
items.body: Match the primary weakness from the Bestiary. Secondary is fine only if your raw is much higher.

items.heading: Trap kit
items.body: Carry 1 Pitfall and 1 Shock Trap plus 2 Tranq Bombs for captures.

items.heading: Healing
items.body: 10 Mega Potions, 3 First Aid Med+, and 1 Lifepowder for the team.

items.heading: Ammo and coatings
items.body: Restock bowgun ammo and coatings. Elemental ammo disappears fast.

items.heading: Buddy check
items.body: Assign a Support buddy with heal or cleanse before a long hunt.

sections.title: Capture vs Slay
sections.subtitle: Know the difference before the monster limps away.

items.heading: When to capture
items.body: Capture at 20% HP or less. Limping, sleeping, or a skull icon means it is ready.

items.heading: Trap order
items.body: Place a trap on the monster's path, wait for the snare, then use 2 Tranq Bombs.

items.heading: Rewards
items.body: Captures give more materials per run; slaying gives carves plus head and tail breaks.

items.heading: Elder Dragons
items.body: Kushala Daora and other elders cannot be trapped. Slay them.

sections.title: Waypoint Exploration
sections.subtitle: Fast travel is free; walking is not.

items.heading: Unlock first
items.body: Activate every waypoint you pass. Fast travel costs nothing and saves minutes.

items.heading: Resource loop
items.body: Gather honey and herbs on the way to the target; you never have enough potions.

items.heading: Hidden paths
items.body: Climbable ledges are marked with white paint. Use them to skip the main trail.

items.heading: Boulder
items.body: Drop a boulder when the monster roars under a cliff for a free knockdown.

items.heading: Paratoad
items.body: Kick a Paratoad near the target to paralyze it for a long damage window.

items.heading: Flashfly
items.body: Flashflies blind flying monsters. Use them before a Rathalos dive.

items.heading: Vine snare
items.body: Vine snares hold ground monsters for 4-5 seconds.

sections.title: Field Crafting
sections.subtitle: Never walk back to camp for a potion again.

items.heading: Mega Potion
items.body: Potion + Honey. Craft in the field when your bag runs dry.

items.heading: Max Potion
items.body: Mega Potion + Mandragora. Full heal and max HP refill.

items.heading: Antidote
items.body: Antidote Herb + Blue Mushroom for poison.

items.heading: Energy Drink
items.body: Nitroshroom + Honey restores stamina.

items.heading: Nulberry
items.body: Carry Nulberries to cleanse Fireblight and Iceblight.

sections.title: Team Roles
sections.subtitle: One of each is stronger than three of the same.

items.heading: Assault
items.body: Burst the weak point and keep element pressure up.

items.heading: Disruptor
items.body: Chain traps, mounts, and status to create openings.

items.heading: Support
items.body: Heal, cleanse, and buff. A dead support is worse than no support.

items.heading: Synergy
items.body: Aim for 1 Assault + 1 Disruptor + 1 Support sharing the monster's primary element.

ailments.name: Poison
ailments.effect: HP drains over time and interrupts healing.
ailments.tip: Herbal Medicine also heals a little.

ailments.name: Paralysis
ailments.effect: You cannot move or attack; the monster gets a free hit.
ailments.tip: Mash inputs to shorten the stun.

ailments.name: Sleep
ailments.effect: You fall asleep; the next hit deals heavy damage.
ailments.tip: Never sleep next to a charging monster.

ailments.name: Blastblight
ailments.effect: Explodes after a short delay or when hit.
ailments.tip: Stop attacking and roll three times.

ailments.name: Defense Down
ailments.effect: Defense drops sharply; heavy hits can cart you.
ailments.tip: Refresh defense before the next big opening.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.effect: Burn damage over time; rolling removes it.
ailments.tip: Roll three times to put out the fire.

ailments.name: Iceblight
ailments.tip: Do not start a long combo while iceblighted.

ailments.name: Stun
ailments.effect: Stars circle your head and the next combo is free for the monster.
ailments.tip: Mash and move; a teammate can also hit you out of it.

emergencyRecipes.name: Max Potion
emergencyRecipes.effect: Full heal plus max HP refill.
